messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED (P1) - MapleHealth private VPC - NLB targets unhealthy + outbound egress failures. Paging Ops Oncall.

Ops Oncall: got the page, looking now.

Alex P: seeing 502/504 spikes from MapleHealth private endpoint. NLB target group shows 0/3 healthy in us-east-1a. Traffic spiky around 14:03 UTC. Customer reports errors from their app.

Maria G: any recent changes to security groups or routes? That pattern smells like egress/SNAT or healthcheck failure.

Kevin L: I ran the maintenance window on that tenant's infra at 13:55 - I moved a haproxy instance and tightened a security-group rule to remove 0.0.0.0/0 egress temporarily.

Sophie H: oh — did you also update the target group's registered IPs? The private pool depends on outbound to internet via NAT for model fetch & health check.

Alex P: reproducing from inside the VPC: curl to target on 443 returns timeout. NLB health check shows TCP failed.

Deploy Bot: build/12345 deployed to maplehealth-private-us-east-1 at 13:50 (no config changes to services).

Maria G: can you paste the SG id?

Kevin L: sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h was updated. I removed outbound 0.0.0.0/0 rule to restrict during maintenance per request.

Alex P: that would be it. The worker nodes need egress to fetch certs and perform health probes to the internal model cache. NLB health checks reach the app via host networking which requires egress.

Infra: copying commands —
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:..:targetgroup/tn-maple-xyz
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
```

Maria G: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert sg change (fast). 2) add a temporary egress rule allowing the specific SNAT/NAT gateway IPs or 0.0.0.0/0 for ports 80/443. 3) re-register targets to a fallback NLB in different AZ if available.

Kevin L: I'll revert the SG change now and add a scoped egress to the NAT gateway. Rolling back in 30s.

Alex P: doing quick health check watch.

(30s)

Kevin L: rolled back sg -> restored outbound 0.0.0.0/0 ports 80,443 to allow egress.

Alex P: re-run describe-target-health -> now 3/3 healthy. Traffic returning to baseline. Curl to local target succeeds `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`.

Customer Eng: I notified MapleHealth support: they saw a spike from 14:03-14:14 UTC, some 502s for user-facing API. They've opened an internal ticket, asking for RCA and ETA.

Ops Oncall: handing off to Maria G for incident lead and post-incident ops. I'm going offline to finish current pager tasks. Maria, please update status page and coordinate customer comms.

Maria G: noted. I'll set a temporary DNS/route fallback in case this recurs and kick off a postmortem. Immediate customer impact: approx 11 minutes elevated errors, tenant isolation prevented cross-tenant blast but still customer-facing.

Sophie H: suggested follow-ups: - add change-control tag when removing egress rules for private tenants - pre-change canary (one node) - add a guardrail to block SG outbound removals if tenant relies on NAT.

Infra: operational actions logged: reverted SG, validated NAT gateway connectivity, rechecked internal Route53 private zone record `api.maplehealth.private` (unchanged). TTL was 60s. No DNS change performed.

Kevin L: adding note — during maintenance I intended to restrict outbound but missed a dependency doc. Apologies.

Maria G: timeline and RCA to be compiled. Immediate mitigations completed and cluster healthy as of 14:14 UTC. Customer-facing error window 14:03-14:14 UTC.

Customer Eng: MapleHealth asks for confirmation that we will not repeat this during next maintenance and requests a postmortem within 48 hours. I'll coordinate the external summary.

Maria G: action items: 1) postmortem doc + timeline (owner: Maria G) 2) runbook change to require canary and change-control tags (owner: Sophie H) 3) infra guardrail to prevent outbound removal without explicit approval (owner: Infra) 4) add automated healthcheck fallback to re-register targets to standby NLB (owner: Kevin L).

Ops Oncall: incident flagged for follow-up, closing active pager.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - P1 - MapleHealth private VPC - resolved and mitigated.

Maria G: closing thread here, will post the RCA link when ready. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
